parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance to which the VPC-connected instance is connected.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:
- If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 20.
- If the value you set is greater than 500, the default value is 500.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The IDs of network interface controllers (NICs).

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceName
parameters.description: The name of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can use this parameter to filter network interface controllers (NICs) by name.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

- If this is the first query or no next query exists, leave this parameter empty.
- If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: PrimaryIpAddress
parameters.description: The primary private IP IPv4 address of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can use this parameter to filter network interface controllers (NICs) by primary private IP address.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The ID of a vSwitch in the VPC-connected instance.

You can query network interface controller (NIC) information for only one vSwitch at a time.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC-connected instance.
